params.filter: his combo: gain over 100% and locked supply high tercile

by_market.market: guessed lockup (180 d) only, best hedge

trades.reason: first pass window, short day -2 open to day +2 close

sizing_note: equity curve, total return, Sharpe and max DD compound each trade at 10% of equity; avg trade and t-stat are per trade, unsized

costs.borrow_note: no real borrow feed, this is a grid charged on calendar days held

data_used: SEC EDGAR full-index form.gz 2010 to 2025 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/full-index/), 424B4 filing text streamed from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/
Yahoo Finance daily via yfinance for every IPO ticker plus IWM and SPY, cached in alpha/2_lockup/data_cache/ (gitignored)
failed_parts: 772 IPOs in the EDGAR universe have no usable Yahoo history (delisted, acquired, ticker reused, or day 0 not inside the data). They are dropped, not filled. Survivorship: the names that died are the ones missing.
102 filings had no readable lock-up sentence, fell back to 180 days and carry lockup_guessed = true (reported separately).
No real borrow feed. Borrow is a grid (0, 10, 30, 100% a year) charged on calendar days held. Small foreign ADRs and $4 micro cap IPOs are often impossible to borrow at all.
Shares outstanding after the offering is parsed from the prospectus text and is approximate (some filings give one share class only).
Yahoo prices are split adjusted, so levels on names that later reverse split look odd. Every return is a ratio, so it is unaffected.
